font-size:30px;"><span style="font-size:30px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:poppins-black;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="color:rgb(71, 136, 175);" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:30px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:poppins-black;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="color:rgb(71, 136, 175);" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Everything you need to know about Mui Ne kiting and winging.</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></h4></div><div id="comp-m956rrgl1" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-m956rrgl1 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.4em; font-size:18px;"><span style="font-size:18px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:montserrat;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="color:rgb(28, 44, 54);" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Want to know when to come to Mui Ne, Vietnam for kiting and winging? We&rsquo;ve put together all the information you need to know before booking your trip. Mui Ne has two main spots&mdash;main beach and Malibu, and two seasons. The winter high season runs from October to April, and the summer low season from May to September. The best wind is in January and December, where you&rsquo;ll find perfect kickers and strong, consistent wind almost every single day.&nbsp;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.4em; font-size:18px;"><span style="font-size:18px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:montserrat;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="color:rgb(28, 44, 54);" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixGuard wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

stay.</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></h4></div><div id="comp-m956thfs7" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-m956thfs7 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:18px;">Getting to Mui Ne is easy. Fly into Ho Chi Minh city, and then take a bus, train or private car to Mui Ne, just near the city of Phan Thiet. Luxurious buses with fully reclining, private-curtained seats are less than $10USD, and a private car straight from the airport is around $50. Stay at a luxury resort like Sea Horse (where Surfpoint is located!), or an affordable, comfortable guest house like our very own <span style="text-decoration:underline;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><a href="https://maps.app.goo.gl/EMWFCzRYWifrZvxT6" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Phong Phi Guesthouse</a></span>.</p>
